Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei sat near Broadcom CEO Hock Tan, while OpenAI president Greg Brockman was seated near Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick. Another group included Palantir CEO Alex Karp, White House technology adviser Michael Kratsios and FTC Chairman Andrew Ferguson. Google CEO Sundar Pichai and executives from AMD, Micron, ServiceNow and Palo Alto Networks also attended.
